review_text: This is easily one of my favorite spots! The food and coffee are consistently high quality, but what really sets it apart is the atmosphere. It’s incredibly cohesive for both deep-work sessions and Bible studies. I love that the space is filled with encouraging Bible verses, it’s such a thoughtful touch. The staff is friendly, the facilities are spotless, and the internet is reliable. Truly a peaceful and productive environment!

There are some good reasons to go here, maybe not 10,000, but still some good ones. It’s clean, comfortable, spacious, well decorated, great views from outside(5th floor), good food, good coffee, helpful friendly staff, free WiFi and clean CR. Went here on a Saturday morning around 10 for coffee and breakfast. We ordered the Durian Cappuccino, White Chocolate Macadamia Latte, Bacon and Egg, Pork Tocino with Egg and a Chocolate Almond Muffin. The Durian Cappuccino was uniquely bold and flavorful while the White Chocolate Macadamia Latte was smooth lightly sweetened. Both meals were well prepared and delicious and the muffin really topped off the meal being sweet and moist. This was really a good experience and worth giving a try. Enjoy!
The staffs are welcoming and the atmosphere is great. Perfect for college students and group works. Also, as an introvert, it's a perfect place to be alone because you have your own space.
Seriously loved this cafe! It's so cute and peaceful, perfect for hanging out with friends. The food was delicious, and that strawberry drink? To die for! Highly recommend.

This place is a really good spot for studying, especially for students who need a quiet and comfortable environment to focus on their schoolwork. The Wi-Fi connection is strong, stable, and fast, which makes it very convenient for online classes, research, and completing assignments without interruptions. The atmosphere is relaxing and not too noisy, so it is easy to concentrate for long hours.
It is a cozy place with fast Wi-Fi, making it very ideal for studying. The male and female restrooms are also separate, and the drinks taste great!❤️
